characters.tooltip: Throws a sound charge that explodes after a short delay.
characters.feel: Choose a dangerous moment of stillness, then release pressure.
characters.proposal: Each 30 consecutive stationary simulation ticks stores one note, up to three. Movement resets the partial stillness timer but preserves earned notes. Regular automatic casts do not consume one or two notes. Once three are stored, the next starter cast consumes all three once for +75% damage on that cast. No storage during pause, menus or death; death clears the bank. No charge-input button.

characters.tooltip: Leaves beat marks at your position. They arm after a delay and pulse at nearby enemies.
characters.feel: Draw the fight with your route and let pursuers meet the delayed beat.
characters.proposal: Replace periodic placement with one mark per 40 world units traveled at baseline cooldown. Cooldown bonuses reduce this threshold with a 24-unit floor. Keep the existing first pulse at age 25 and later pulses every 45 ticks. Pending marks cannot be evicted before their first pulse. Bound the pending queue at eight per owner; when full, suppress placement and cap carried distance at one placement threshold. After a mark pulses, promote it to the armed pool. Start with three armed marks per owner; projectile-count bonuses raise that cap, up to eight. Evict only the oldest already-pulsed mark. Teleports add no trail distance.
characters.state: Per-player actual movement, bounded pending and armed mark queues, and first-pulse state. No client animation counter enters game logic.

characters.tooltip: A silver fan flies out and returns through enemies.
characters.feel: Set up the outward arc and reposition for the return.
characters.proposal: Outgoing hits mark enemies for that owner and cast. The same fan consumes its own marks on return for +30% damage once per marked enemy. Give the fan separate bounded outgoing and returning hit sets and pierce budgets, permitting at most one hit per enemy on each leg. The current lifetime-wide visited filter must change for this attack; adding marks alone is insufficient. Marks expire with the cast; other players and later casts cannot consume them.
characters.state: Owner/cast/enemy marks, separate per-leg hit ledgers and bounded pierce budgets, and one return-consumption flag per mark.
